text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Those who love racing often say,

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "The Twinkle Series has officially entered a golden age!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "The crowd goes wild! In this very 'now', where countless stars gather!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Running at the forefront of the era and forging legendary battles—
Stay Gold and Silence Suzuka!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Closing in on those girls is—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“The country-bred supernova!
Soaring rapidly toward becoming the best in Japan,
Special Week!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Aiming to reign supreme over the racing world through her powerful character and overwhelming skill: T.M. Opera O!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Led by the two of them,
a new brilliance is now
sending shockwaves through the racing world!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Has there ever been an era graced by such magnificent Umamusume before?!
————No, never!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "『Feast your eyes! Upon this golden era!! Upon these supreme battles of glory!!!』"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Everything about racing exists right here, right NOW!!"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
――...Special Week and
TM Opera O, you say?
choice_data_list: Yeah. She'll be a threat from here on out.
Yeah. She should be a threat from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, hahaha—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Hahahaha...!!
Is that so...! Is that how it works...?!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Well, that's about the size of it.
To put it simply—"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
It kind of feels like everyone with a connection to this
is gathering together at full force... somehow.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
For me right now, aiming for the "center of the era,"
this is a wish come true.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: —Because if I can beat everyone, I'll shine the brightest.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Yeah. For now, the question is how we approach the next race, the Takarazuka Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
The threats you mentioned were
Spe and her friends, Opera O and her group...
and Suzuka, who's returning soon, right?
choice_data_list: Yeah. Though we still don't know who else is entering.
Yeah. We don't know who's entering yet, though.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...Maybe that sort of thing
really just depends on us after all.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Alright, this is a good opportunity.
Maybe I'll go check in on everyone soon.

text_block_list.name: Spe & Grass
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant, pant*...—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Spe-chan, thank you for pacing with me.
That was a truly bracing session.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Right back at you, Grass-chan...!
It was super inspiring for me too...!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Ooh, sparks were really flying between you two.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah, Stego-san! Hello~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She's the Special Week everyone's been talking about lately.
An Umamusume from the countryside with a rustic, innocent vibe, but her skills are guaranteed to be the real deal.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hello.
Are you doing some training too, Stego-san?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This is Grass Wonder. In the current racing world,
she's rising to prominence right alongside Special Week.
She's a classic Yamato Nadeshiko of an Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: "No, I just saw you two running alongside each other and stopped to watch for a bit."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
They're both totally fired up...
...At each other, that is.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Because they're someone I cannot lose to.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I haven't run with Grass-chan yet, so...!
I'm really looking forward to racing with her someday!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Haha, it's a great thing.
Having rivals... like that.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: If the two of you were to face off, it'd definitely be an incredible matchup—a thrilling race, no doubt.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe,
I'd be so happy if that were true...!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: That said—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"As I am now,
I might not let it be a race between just the two of you."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh...—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...Sorry for intruding.
Well then, see you—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
O-Opera O-san... Why aren't you
training at the Academy today...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I simply surrendered myself to destiny.
After all, it is about time the cast gathered.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: —Am I listed among those actors of yours?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Of course! Stego-san!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She is T.M. Opera O.
Though her theatrical, grandiose demeanor stands out,
she possesses a genuine strength that easily backs it up.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
In this miraculous era, you are an emissary of fate,
connecting with countless radiant lights—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: That they could become a guide who brings even greater brilliance to the legend of the End-of-Century Overlord!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...Heeh.
You sure think highly of me.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I was certain it was Doto's role
to add color to your legend, though.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
M-Me...!?
Th-That's far too much honor for someone like me...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Meisho Doto. She seems to have a modest personality,
but she's apparently had close battles with T.M. Opera O
time and time again, so her ability is undeniable."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Doto is someone indispensable to me, capable of being
my lifelong rival. Our mutual singularity.
However, you are different.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You intend to show your running equally to both me and Doto.
...Not as an archrival, but as a guiding star.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And in doing so, you shall add
a brand-new spectacle to my path of conquest.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
As part of the performance,
I might just drag you down from your throne, you know?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha!
Just try it if you think you can!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The Overlord rejects no one.
No matter how chaotic the stage may be, I shall always be the strongest and most beautiful!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Nice. Now that's what I'm talking about.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...――

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: —Phew...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Looks like you're completely back in top shape.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Stego-senpai. Thanks to you.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Right now, more than anything... I just want to run soon.
...With Stego-senpai, and everyone else.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Huh.
With everyone, huhâ

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...I'm looking forward to it too.
To running with you again, along with
Bright, Fukukitaru, and the others.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Wouldn't it be interesting to have a showdown
between rivals of the same generation for the first time since the Japan Derby?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
If such a race could come true...—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I feel like I can run even faster.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: "Haha! That's so like Suzuka."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: "...When that time comes, I'll make sure to run even faster than I do now."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: So that I won't lose to you all.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Well then...
We've met everyone for today, but—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Did you feel something?
choice_data_list: ...I was just wondering if each of them has some sort of history.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Well, surely even you
can understand that much by now."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"...The me in that other world
ran the Takarazuka Kinen at least four times."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Before long, I realized there were several "what ifs" out there.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: —What if she had barged into that clash between the top two?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: —What if she had rebelled against the darling of the era?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: —What if she had been able to compete with her generation again?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Which "what-if" do you think
sounds the most interesting?
choice_data_list: Crashing the Showdown Between the Two Favorites
Rebellion Against the Darling of the Era

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Well then, maybe I'll hand these off to them next time~.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: A challenge.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: —And with that, the Takarazuka Kinen. I'm looking forward to running with you all.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: "Me too! I'll give it my all to show Stego-san!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Witness the run of an Umamusume aiming to be the best in Japan!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I shall also do my very best
to serve as your opponent.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Let us have a serious duel.
...Brace yourself.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Haha.
...Same to you."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Lying beyond the choice that awaits. The stage of dreams.
What the traveler sees there is—"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Well then, maybe I'll hand these off to them next time~.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: A challenge.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: —And with that, the Takarazuka Kinen. I'm looking forward to running with you all.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha!!
It appears the time for my reign has already arrived!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Feast your eyes.
Upon my majesty!!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I'll give it my all...!
Without messing up...! I'll run...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose to Stego-san......
O-Or Opera O-san either......!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. That's the spirit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Lying beyond the choice that awaits. The stage of dreams.
What the traveler sees there is—"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Well then, maybe I'll hand these off to them next time~.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: A challenge.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: —And with that, the Takarazuka Kinen. I'm looking forward to racing alongside all my classmates.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...Senpai, are you even faster
than you were at the 'Tenno Sho (Autumn)'?"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Of course.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Then I'll just have to run faster than that.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: And toward a brand-new view...!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Haha!
That's the Suzuka I know."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Lying beyond the choice that awaits. The stage of dreams.
What the traveler sees there is—"
